caption: The drawing depicts a single heeled women's boot facing right, rendered in shades of black and dark gray. The boot covers the ankle and features a narrow, pointed toe adorned with a small bow on top near the base of the lacing. The lacing runs vertically up the front of the boot, through a series of evenly spaced small eyelets, and is tied at the top with visible loops and lace ends hanging down. Decorative stitching outlines various parts of the boot, including the toe cap, heel, and side panels. The upper edge of the boot is trimmed with a textured, scalloped detail. The heel of the boot is curved inward and mid-height, with a visible lighter area where the heel meets the sole. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white or cream color, with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Woman's Shoe
